name: Sitcom Toons
why: The user's series is a two-character comic dialogue with flat cartoon friends cutting back and forth — the film keeps that grammar with our own hand-coded characters.
look: Two flat vector cartoon friends drawn in code — Beni (glasses, kippah, white shirt) on a teal ground, Avi (black tee) on warm sand; hard cuts on every line; props (calendar, cloud, key, crickets) pop beside them on their words; a final two-shot in the rain.
elements: the two cartoon friends (mood + arms per line, mouth on the words)
props: calendar page, sun, rain cloud, golden key, crickets
an Amida map with a pointer and return arrows
motion: Hard cut on every line; props spring in on their word; the speaker breathes and talks; rain falls at the end.
